image_description: A top-down close-up view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky substrate. The organism has an elongated oval shape with a distinct reddish-pink leathery girdle surrounding eight overlapping, transversely ribbed calcareous plates. The plates exhibit a mottled pattern of brown, cream, and greenish hues with prominent growth lines. The background consists of dark, textured rock with patches of pink coralline algae.

The overlapping mechanism of the plates is visually correct, but the depth separation between the overlapping edges is somewhat ambiguous and lacks sharp shadow definition, suggesting minor geometric flattening common in AI generation.
